title: Purple Moon Sorceress
description: A young female character with white hair in buns stands in a dynamic pose against a solid dark gray background. She wears a white and purple traditional-style outfit with wide sleeves, a sash, and matching boots, while holding two large purple crescent moons with a glowing purple star halo floating above her head.
prompt: A confident young woman with pale skin and white hair styled in two buns stands in a martial arts pose, wearing an ornate white and purple traditional fantasy outfit with wide sleeves, a wide sash, and matching boots. Solid dark gray background, clean anime-influenced digital illustration style.
